method.group: Unweighted mean of the published means of matching ISCO-08 four-digit unit groups.
method.country: Employment-weighted mean of displayed group reference scores, over matched employment only.
method.composition_range: Employment-weighted minima/maxima of constituent unit-group means; not confidence intervals and not calibrated for local tasks.
method.country_adjustment: None. Local task content, adoption, infrastructure and skills are not observed.
method.india_mapping: Direct ILOSTAT ISCO-08 two-digit employment counts, like the other five countries; no NCO-to-ISCO conversion or PLFS percentage scaling.
method.missing: Unmatched groups are null and excluded from means; their employment remains in the map and coverage denominator.
method.grades: Published four-digit gradients are shown only at four-digit level; no gradient or high-exposure headcount is inferred from a group mean.
